name: Mermaid Sequins
description: Reversible sequins brushed into swirls: each disc turned by a smooth field, showing its gold face or its jewel face and thinning to an edge where it stands halfway between.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { z-index: @y; --a: @rn(-200, 560, 1.3); --k: $(cos(a / 57.2958)); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -5%; border-radius: 50%; background: @match($(k) > 0, @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)), @p(var(--color3), var(--color4))); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 12%, #000 12%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 12%, #000 12%); -webkit-transform: scaleX($(max(0.08, abs(k)))); transform: scaleX($(max(0.08, abs(k)))); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
